newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: SOCCER-SQUADS AT THE 11TH ASIAN CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SQUADS AT THE 11TH ASIAN CUP.

text.p: Following are the official squad lists of the 12 finalists at the Asian soccer Cup starting on Wednesday in the United Arab Emirates (opening games on Wednesday: United Arab Emirates v South Korea; Indonesia v Kuwait).
